name: Zumpo/Cup
description:
A player at the table and their dice: their own face up, anybody else's Hidden until a call, Empty for a die already lost. Turn marks whose turn it is; Lost, outlined in danger, the player who loses a die in a reveal. Up to five dice; hide the ones a game does not have. Layout=Row lists a cup as one row, the dice at its end, for a phone's table in a 3-dice game; five dice keep Stack.
Motion: when a round starts, every die still in play gives a 0.4 s shake, as if just rolled; none when the system asks for reduced motion.
